digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciliation live harness suite
propositions: The reconciler must prove bidirectional mutation round-trips against a real Jira Data Center instance using a copy of the actual project ticket store, not an empty instance.

Isolation must be enforced by physical separation (no git remote on the working repo) and verified by test, combined with scrubbing all .bridge_state* artifacts and production Jira bindings from the copied store.
Each of 28 mutations (14 inbound, 14 outbound) must be individually asserted to round-trip through named oracles reading the actual remote state, with per-mutation idempotence verified separately.

Pagination must be exercised by observing the server's effective page size, seeding 2×observed+1 issues to force three pages, and asserting full recovery of all seeded issues through the inbound snapshot.
